name: DP Cheesesteaks (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi) Grilled Chicken or Ribeye & Provolone ("Wiz Witout")
brandOrRestaurant: DP Cheesesteaks (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi, UT)
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved chicken breast or ribeye steak Chop-Griddled on an authentic soft Amoroso hoagie roll with mild aged provolone cheese ("witout" onions/peppers) is soft, low-fiber, and easy to chew.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Plain Chicken or Steak Provolone Cheesesteak "Witout" (NO grilled onions, NO bell peppers, NO jalapenos, and provolone instead of processed Cheez Whiz).
watchOuts: Choose aged Provolone cheese instead of liquid Cheez Whiz (high lactose + emulsifiers) and always order "witout" onions
